failed_cases_preserved.failure: HTTP 503 while concurrently attaching Omni workers to the multiprocess router; failure precedes learner initialization.
failed_cases_preserved.reproduced_mechanism: The native data plane rejects more than 16 simultaneous admin forwards per process. A four-process router receiving a 64-request burst reproduced HTTP 503 with 'too many concurrent admin requests'. Shared-socket distribution is not guaranteed even.
failed_cases_preserved.attribution_limit: The original GPU exception records the status and URL, not the response body. The same-scale CPU reproducer identifies a matching failure mechanism; repaired GPU execution is still required for acceptance.
failed_cases_preserved.repair: Size bounded per-data-plane admin admission to max(128, 2 * worker_count); preserve request-body limits, separate forwarding and heartbeat pools, and the all-data-plane snapshot acknowledgement fence. No retries or sleeps hide a publication race.
